name: calculate-birth-charts
description: Deterministically calculate Western natal charts (with sidereal zodiac, true node and asteroids), Four Pillars/BaZi (四柱八字) and Zi Wei Dou Shu (紫微斗数), a sourced reading with 吉凶/喜用神/大运流年 facts, and 1-5 person 合婚/relationship synastry. All math is done by a bundled offline CLI; the model never computes charts.
